verdict: Organic visibility is softening across all three entities this week.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all inbound activity this period came exclusively from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns were active. Combined GBP actions totalled 383 over 28 days, but engagement dropped sharply in the most recent 7 days: down 58% at Forte, 85% at Advance Grinding, and 57% at O'Hare, with all three profiles showing zero actions over the final 3–4 days of the window. A cluster of overdue deliverables — including CRM data reconciliation, a Web/SEO root-cause fix, and outreach sequence launches — is being escalated and resolved this period to unblock downstream activity. Once those items clear, the outreach sequences and SEO recovery work targeting all three brands will move forward, and profile optimization is underway to improve call conversion from existing impressions.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement fell to zero across all entities in the final days of this period, coinciding with an overdue Web/SEO root-cause fix that is gating profile and search recovery.
watch_item.fix: The SEO blocker is being resolved this month, with three site reindexing efforts and a full profile optimization review already in motion to restore visibility.
